narrative.details:
Wildkin are quite unpredictable creatures, adventurer. Capable of incredible gentleness, these creatures will show extreme ferocity if something they deem important is threatened.

These beasts are rumored to have been created by Elune, and I am interested in finding if this is really the truth.

Recently, I heard about a population of wildkin living in the Hinterlands -- Vicious, Primitive, and Savage Owlbeasts. They can be found amongst the wildlife there. Will you gather some wildkin feathers for me?
narrative.objectives: Collect 15 Wildkin Feathers from the Hinterlands for Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for bringing these to me, adventurer.What did you learn of the Wildkin?Perhaps these feathers will tell us more. Ferocious monsters, or simply misguided pets? One day I'd like to know the truth...I am going to continue my research -- please come back and talk to me again after some time has passed.
narrative.requestItemsText: Try to avoid them if you can, adventurer. The Wildkin may misread your interest as an intent to do them harm...
